data.one_liner: A headless, fully customizable toast system for Flutter with physics‑based animations.
data.what_it_does: Manages toast queuing, animation, gestures and multi‑position viewers while letting you provide the UI. Offers theming, motion policies and independent stacks.
use_when: You need custom toast designs beyond simple text‑only toasts
You want physics‑based, gesture‑rich notifications with multiple viewers
You require theming and motion policy control
avoid_when: You only need a quick, out‑of‑the‑box toast like FlutterToast
You need push or system notifications rather than in‑app UI
You prefer a solution that includes its own widget UI
strengths: Multiple independent viewers and theming support
weaknesses: Requires you to build the toast widget UI
May be overkill for simple toast needs
data.setup_notes: Add zentoast to pubspec, wrap app with ToastProvider, no native permissions required

alternatives.name: fluttertoast
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a simple out‑of‑the‑box toast with minimal setup
